teaser: The gate at the dog park never quite latches, and you're the one who checks it twice anyway before letting the leash go slack. Life path 11 and the four letters ISFP meet in that small, careful motion: a nature built for feel and color, carrying a number known for an almost electric sensitivity to everything in the air. The 11 asks for a kind of broadcast — presence that reaches people without trying. ISFP works close, in detail, in the moment right in front of it. Crossed, the reach of the number and the closeness of the type don't automatically speak the same language, and most of what follows is about the translation between them.
